sentences.text: It is the contention of the learned counsel for the appellant-Insurance company that, the driver of the lorry bearing registration No.MH-04/DD-3804 did not possess the valid and effective driving licence to drive the vehicle in question.

In that view of the matter, following the declaration of law by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Gurmail Singh Vs. Bajaj Allianz General Insruance Company Limited, and another, reported in 2019 ACJ 713, it is open for the appellant/Insurance Company to recover the amount of compensation made by the learned Commissioner after paying the same to the claimant at the earliest.

opennyai_summary.arguments: It is the contention of the learned counsel for the appellant-Insurance company that, the driver of the lorry bearing registration No.MH-04/DD-3804 did not possess the valid and effective driving licence to drive the vehicle in question.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: In that view of the matter, following the declaration of law by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Gurmail Singh Vs. Bajaj Allianz General Insruance Company Limited, and another, reported in 2019 ACJ 713, it is open for the appellant/Insurance Company to recover the amount of compensation made by the learned Commissioner after paying the same to the claimant at the earliest.
opennyai_summary.decision:
4. In that view of the matter, the Judgment and award dated 06.06.2018 passed in ECA No.3/2016 is modified to the extent that the appellant/Insurance NC: 2026:KHC-K:1092 HC-KAR company shall pay the compensation of Rs.8,65,000/- along with interest at the rate of 12% per annum from the date of accident till realization to the claimants and thereafter recover the same from the respondent-owner.
5. Accordingly, the following:
ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed in-part;
(ii) The respondent No.2-Insurance company is directed to satisfy the award amount along with interest awarded by the learned Commissioner and recover the same later from the owner of the vehicle.
